THE_TACTICAL_NON_TRIGGER.why_a_gap_is_not_a_break: A TACTICAL trigger requires a structural level actually breaking NOW, entered near the level so the invalidation is cheap. A level cleared by a gap hands the desk an entry 0.35% ABOVE its own trigger, which is exactly the 2026-08-28T15:05Z late-entry detector: the -30% stop lands back AT the level, so the position cannot be wrong about timing without being wrong about thesis.
